code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated hematocrit/erythrocytes, and increased inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer, INR). Electrolyte disturbances (mild hyperkalemia, hyperchloremia), mild hypoglycemia, and mild renal involvement (elevated urea) are present. The findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible hypoxic stress, and a prothrombotic state. Clinical correlation for infection, hypoxia, and possible hematologic or thromboembolic complications is strongly recommended.
